referenceIdentity: Exact author-deposited REL606 sequence, feature coordinates, types, strands and other qualifiers from Dryad10.5061/dryad.6226d, byte-identical Zenodo source. Source feature IDs are normalized per row; original_id retains author IDs.

transformation.fasta: Extract embedded ##FASTA sequence without changing bases; preserve author sequence ID REL606.
transformation.annotation: Remove embedded FASTA. Assign deterministic per-row IDs from immutable author feature ordinals and retain supplied IDs as original_id. Preserve all source columns1–8 and all other qualifiers. Sort by sequence/start/end for tabix.

identifierNormalization.scheme: REL606.feature.<six-digit 1-based feature ordinal in the immutable author GFF before sorting>
identifierNormalization.originalIdQualifier: original_id retains the exact author ID on rows that supplied one; it is absent on originally unidentified rows.
identifierNormalization.parentRelationships: The author supplied zero Parent attributes. Normalization adds zero Parent attributes or inferred gene/CDS relationships.
identifierNormalization.preservation: All source columns1–8 and every other qualifier are preserved exactly in the source fixture. Replacing generated IDs with original_id, removing original_id, and removing IDs from originally unidentified rows reconstructs the author annotation-row multiset.
identifierNormalization.snpPlacement: SNP placement depends on the unchanged exact reference sequence and reported point coordinates, not feature IDs.

unbundledDerivedArtifacts.name: REL606.authoritative.fasta
unbundledDerivedArtifacts.derivation: Extract embedded ##FASTA sequence without changing bases; preserve author sequence ID REL606.
unbundledDerivedArtifacts.availability: Uncompressed preparation derivative is not bundled. The exact source is the deposited REL606.gff3 named in authoritativeSources.

unbundledDerivedArtifacts.name: REL606.annotations.gff3
unbundledDerivedArtifacts.derivation: Original author annotation rows with embedded FASTA removed and coordinate sorting only, before per-row feature-ID normalization.
unbundledDerivedArtifacts.availability: Uncompressed preparation derivative is not bundled. The exact source is the deposited REL606.gff3 named in authoritativeSources.

nativeCompatibility.nativeIdentifierEmission: The existing native importer emits its own coordinate/type IDs; original_id remains available.
nativeCompatibility.nonCdsPhases: The existing native importer emits . for non-CDS phases; the source fixture retains the author phase column unchanged.
